card.name: Words pointing to past or prior events
card.fires_on: Small words and word parts just before a term about something past, previous or hidden, such as 'years after', 'previous radiation', 'resolved infection' or 'occult bleeding'.

modes.label: Before prior treatment or past history
modes.description: Linking word right before a term meaning earlier radiation, earlier infection or earlier time.
modes.example: Monitor patients for inflammation or blistering in areas<< of>> previous radiation treatment.

modes.label: Time gaps in history
modes.description: A number or word that starts a count of years or a past date.
modes.example: will start soon in Johannesburg,<< ten>> years after the Rio Earth Summit .

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Partway through a long drug name, such as daunorubicin or chemoradiation.
modes.example: Cumulative Exposure of Daun<<or>>ubicin per Cycle of VYX
